unsupported: The shop produces a range of metal roofing panels including PBR, PANEL, DESERT RIB, Zia Lock standing seam, PBU, and 7/8-inch corrugated profiles in 24, 26, and 29 gauge.
Customers include roofing contractors, commercial builders, and residential project managers throughout New Mexico.
The supplier positions itself as a one-stop source for panel profiles, trim, and accessories needed for metal roof installations.
The business was founded on the premise that local fabrication and stock depth reduce lead times for contractors.
